content_blocks.text: The night was thick with mystery, the air heavy with the scent of wet earth and distant thunder. The old oak tree stood sentinel in the middle of the clearing, its branches reaching out like bony fingers. As the first drops of rain began to fall, a figure emerged from the shadows, cloaked in darkness. The moonlight caught the glint of a pendant hanging around the figure’s neck, an ancient symbol that whispered of forgotten rituals and dark magic.
